LHX.sentence: L3Harris is down slightly, but the real story is that its profit margins are running well below what the other big defense contractors earn — so this deep slump reflects a genuine business problem to fix, not just market jitters.

ASML.sentence: ASML eased back a touch this week — it's still the only company on earth that makes the machines for the most advanced chips, but the stock is priced richly enough that trimming a little makes sense.

LIN.sentence: Linde is quiet this week — industrial gas demand is steady and, unusually, this very high-quality company is priced about in line with its peers rather than at its usual premium.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft is calm, with its Azure cloud business still growing fast as AI demand keeps humming along — no drama here.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher is holding steady, and there's an encouraging sign: biotech funding has been thawing lately, which usually translates into more lab-equipment orders for them a couple of quarters down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge, the pipeline toll-road business, slipped a bit and pays a generous dividend, though it's fairly priced rather than a genuine bargain at the moment.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow has fallen well off its high even as similar companies have risen, which is unusual, but big companies and the government keep signing on for its workflow-automation and AI tools.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore, the big miner and commodity trader, is having an unremarkable week — metals prices have it sitting right in the middle of its normal cycle, neither cheap nor expensive.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta slipped, but the price it gets for a ton of rock is still climbing nicely — the apparent dip in average price is just a quirk of its recent acquisitions, so the business is intact (and note its reported earnings look artificially large right now, so don't read the stock as a bargain).

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA is steady, with the Mexican peso sitting in its normal range — which matters because most of this Latin American Coke bottler's sales are in pesos.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is having a good stretch — oil prices are near multi-year highs and sit far above what it costs this Brazilian oil giant to pump, which tends to mean generous dividends.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the Danish container-shipping giant, is barely moving, but the stock is priced below what its fleet of ships would cost to replace — the kind of level that often marks a low point for a cyclical business.

MA.sentence: Mastercard ticked up and, unusually, is priced slightly cheaper than Visa right now even though it's the faster grower — people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: The surgical robot company had a good day, and its shares are now at their biggest discount in three years relative to their own history, even as hospitals keep doing more operations with its machines.
